# V0-L1: research-owned runtime and durable scientific jobs

## Objective
Implement and demonstrate V0-L1 from the human-authored `2026-11-12-v0-context-lifecycle-design.md`: a production research-owned Codex app-server boundary and computation ownership that outlives individual model contexts. This is the first lifecycle increment, not renewed M5 science. Read PROJECT.md, AGENTS.md, STATUS.md and the complete lifecycle amendment before planning. The amendment supersedes conflicting earlier runtime requirements. Preserve PROJECT.md and the human amendment verbatim.

## Approach and scope
Start from current main and keep this a cohesive V0-L1 increment. Use established Python/Linux execution and ordinary files, with a small research-owned app-server driver. Validate the installed protocol/tool inventory in production isolation. Do not depend on the separate project-manager controller engine or expand it. Reuse proven process/service supervision and isolation mechanisms. Distinguish stable logical task/agent IDs, disposable Codex context IDs and durable computation/job IDs.

Researchers must explicitly choose positive finite computation timeouts, supporting values above 60 seconds and hours. Remove the universal 60-second job limit and clamp to model-context lifetime. The timeout remains independently enforceable over the command and descendants after context termination; replacing context never extends/restarts a job. Provide owning-agent/successor inspection, event-driven waiting, cancellation and retained result retrieval. Avoid repeated model turns solely to poll. A timeout preserves useful partial outputs, records actual cleanup/outcome and returns control without automatically stopping unrelated research or retrying.

Enforce existing human-configured aggregate memory/tasks, simultaneous-agent and concurrent-job caps. Defaults/authorized example limits remain two agents sharing 2048 MiB, zero swap, 128 process/thread tasks, one concurrent admitted job. Surviving jobs and successor contexts share allocations. Retain scoped writes, protected read-only starting evidence, frozen independent-check evidence and exclusion of backend credentials from scientific commands. Contexts/agents cannot enlarge their allocations. Provide a small reusable admission-block and owned-process cleanup path for later STOP/pause. Never treat an unchecked PID or cleanup request as confirmed ownership/termination. Keep real failures observable.

The retained M5 candidate is `cwi/20261111T063907_2732fff6` at `1b70aea25f6c5f8496acdea12e9a27c6f3d4ecbd`, worktree `/home/francesco/Desktop/gits/research_project/research_pipeline/coding_pipeline/logs/20261111T063907_2732fff6/worktree`. It is inactive, blocked at Reviewer turn 21, unmerged and scientifically unaccepted. Preserve its branch/worktree/partial work. Read and selectively reuse relevant workspace, initialization and handoff improvements when needed, documenting provenance. Do not merge/approve/resume that old run or copy its old timer-based harness indiscriminately. M5 reconciliation/acceptance remains a later gate.

## Observable acceptance
1. Production-boundary checks against the installed app-server establish the intended native tool surface plus controlled MCP operations actually work. Unrestricted scientific command execution, credential exposure and writes to protected inputs remain excluded. No unisolated fallback or separate restricted-role escape may stand in for the production path. Keep paid scientific gates disabled in routine tests; no private M5 inputs/investigation in this request.
2. A real admitted scientific computation remains inspectable under the same verified ownership/job ID after its original agent context ends. A successor can wait/collect it without duplicated allocations, restart or changed deadline. Show a real timeout stopping command and descendants after context termination, retaining partial outputs and leaving unrelated research usable.
3. Admission accepts a duration above 60 seconds and an hours-scale value without waiting hours. Use a short expiry exercise for process cleanup and a short public/test-input computation for real survival/result retrieval. Inspect/wait/cancel enforce logical ownership. Actual cancellation/cleanup evidence must distinguish success from uncertainty/failure.
4. Consequential deterministic and real-process tests cover shared allocation enforcement across context replacement, scoped-write/read-only/credential boundaries, realistic supervisor/admission failure and cleanup. Existing useful scientific capabilities remain available or superseded paths/options are explicitly rejected. Do not keep incompatible legacy runtimes merely to pass old implementation-mirroring tests; adapt superseded checks honestly.
5. Normal pipeline independent review and final/required combined checks establish local integration. Provide an explicit report of V0-L1 evidence, commands, receipt/artifact paths, refs, actual limitations and next V0-L2 dependency. Representative native/process validation belongs to this pipeline, including its host final verification when the Writer lacks host prerequisites. Provide a small reproducible opt-in validation path if necessary, with missing enabled prerequisites reported as blockers rather than accepted skips. Do not claim the full V0 extension complete from L1 evidence.

## Constraints and non-goals
Follow PROJECT.md scientific quality/isolation/provenance requirements and AGENTS.md: established libraries, straightforward files, small reversible solutions, abstractions only for real duplication/requirements, consequential tests, realistic error handling; remove superseded complexity where justified. No backward compatibility, state migrations, schema adapters, option shims, distributed scheduler, database/broker, universal workflow/claim framework or bespoke sandbox. Preserve historical science/receipts, human edits and protected starting evidence. Clearly reject unsupported old operational state. No product-manager/controller expansion or component-branch merging. No external disclosure/publication or model substitution. Local product integration is authorized; no remote actions from pipeline roles.

Implement only V0-L1 and unavoidable foundations. Full automatic measured 55% rollover is V0-L2; centralized 15% weekly reserve and 2700-second repeated secondary staleness are V0-L3; scientific opponent/terminal decisions V0-L4; reopening/recovery V0-L5; integrated public live science and updated M5 harness V0-L6. Shape the minimal runtime boundary to support those stated requirements without commissioning them now. Fixed scientific session/investigation/demo lifetimes are superseded; operational test/RPC/shutdown bounds may end a test honestly, never create scientific COMPLETE. No M1–M4 paid demonstration repetitions, M5 scientific run, invented acceptance or hours-long test waits.

The manager trusts pipeline testing/review and will assess reports rather than independently review or rerun completed product work. Resolve ordinary engineering choices autonomously. If a concrete host prerequisite blocks production verification, report exact missing evidence and a supported controller-host invocation; do not weaken verification or grants.
